checks: un-invoiced return: all stages, invoice block, no pre-Finance effects, atomic quantity/stock/invoice, repeat confirmation blocked
partial approval: physical receipt 2 vs credit 1; scrap net-zero stock; Finance rejection/resubmission; draft recalculated; physical quantity cannot be returned twice
missing accounts: CN creation rolled back with status, stock and delivery quantity unchanged
posted invoice on delivery day: exactly one confirmed CN + balanced journal, original invoice immutable; concurrent confirmation executes once
paid invoice: confirmed credit retained for subsequent refund/allocation
warehouse rejection: reason required, no stock/credit effects, invoice block released
sales rejection: reason required, no stock/credit effects, invoice block released
driver historical return: own trip/current customer + exact original order line; retains historical kind and collecting vehicle
unknown historical goods: intake without order number, warehouse matches exact source, no premature stock/CN, repeated matching blocked
injected failure after stock/quantity updates: all stock, quantity, invoice and request changes rolled back; retry succeeds
return registration versus invoice creation: common order lock makes invoicing see the committed pending return
wrong item received: original order credit uses original units; physical stock uses actual product and explicitly verified base-unit quantity
dispatch vehicle: plate normalized and captured with driver on the trip; dispatched plate cannot be overwritten
role separation: warehouse cannot confirm finance requests; driver can read own return sources, not another driver trip or approve returns
